liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Lost Sailor** (1 review): The transition to Saint of Circumstance was a strong, non-bathroom performance [22]
- **Around And Around** (1 review): Bobby's vocals during the transition to One More Saturday Night are highlighted [17]

## The recordings

- **gd1982-04-17.fob.nak700.glassberg.78747.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): source not stated; 23 songs; 171 min; rated 4.67/5 by 6 [1]
- **gd82-04-17.sbd.bertha-ashley.23933.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 21 songs; 177 min; rated 4.14/5 by 22 [2]. Said about its sound: Audio is quieter and less crisp than the recordings from the following two nights [18]
- **gd1982-04-17.146324.dsbd.miller.flac1644**: soundboard; 21 songs; 177 min; rated 3/5 by 2 [3]
- **gd1982-04-17.168798.sbd.cm.miller.t-flac1648**: soundboard; 21 songs; 176 min [4]
- **gd1982-04-17.168778.sbd.cassette.miller.flac2496**: soundboard; 21 songs; 176 min [5]
- **gd82-04-17.set2-sbd.nayfield.332.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 12 songs; 98 min; rated 4.2/5 by 5 [15]. Said about its sound: Audio features good separation and clarity without muddiness, rated five skulls [21]

## Around the show

- Jerry and Phil swayed like backup dancers behind Bob, causing audience laughter [16]
- Band played to people behind the stage, a unique occurrence for the reviewer [23]
- Band turned to play for behind-stage seats, possibly the first arena instance [24]
- Along with April 18, 1982, considered among the best performances at Hartford [16]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1982-04-17.fob.nak700.glassberg.78747.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Barry Glassberg; transferred by Unknown; source: FOB-Nak 700's > Sony D5 recorded by Barry Glassberg [1]
- **gd82-04-17.sbd.bertha-ashley.23933.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [2]
- **gd1982-04-17.146324.dsbd.miller.flac1644**: taped by Larry Oppenheimer; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD > PCM Master (Sony PCM-F1/Maxell HG-T120 VHS) [3]. Also: First digital Grateful Dead recording, using Beyer M160 mics and cassette master [3]
- **gd1982-04-17.168798.sbd.cm.miller.t-flac1648**: transferred by All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller  September 11, 2024; source: SBD > Cassette Master (Sony TC-D5M/Dolby B/TDK SA-X90) [4]. Also: Patch source recorded by Larry Oppenheimer for tape pauses and flips [4]
- **gd1982-04-17.168778.sbd.cassette.miller.flac2496**: transferred by All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller  September 11, 2024; source: SBD > Cassette Master (Sony TC-D5M/Dolby B/TDK SA-X90) [5]. Also: Patch source recorded by Larry Oppenheimer for tape pauses and flips [5]
- **gd82-04-17.set2-sbd.nayfield.332.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [15]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Gregg Nixon Grateful Dead: [1982-04-17 Hartford Civic Center, Hartford, CT, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1982-04-17-hartford-civic-center-hartford-ct-usa/) [29]
- Poster by Gregg Nixon Grateful Dead: [1982-04-18 Hartford Civic Center, Hartford, CT, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1982-04-18-hartford-civic-center-hartford-ct-usa/) [30]
